newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela current account surplus seen at $7 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela current account surplus seen at $7 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's current account surplus will rise to $7 billion from $1.572 in 1995, a high- ranking Central Bank official said.

"In 1996 we'll close the year with a current account surplus that few imagined, some $7 billion," Manuel Lagos, Vice President of Central Bank Studies told the Senate Finance Commission as part of a presentation on the Venezuelan economy by Central Bank governor Antonio Casas Gonzalez.
